action.description: Which conductor to impersonate, or idle/transcribe

attachments.description: Resolved vault-relative paths of embedded attachment files (spec 031, ADR-1/ADR-2). Optional; absent or empty means no resolvable attachment embeds.

embed_target.description: The embed target as written in the note, e.g. 'karte.jpg' or 'Images/karte.jpg'.

candidate_count.description: Number of index hits when status is 'ambiguous'.

unresolved_embeds.description: Embed targets that could not be resolved to exactly one attachment path. Optional; absent or empty means every embed resolved cleanly.

has_audio.description: True if uncached audio files exist in inbox

wire_cache_path.description: ADR-026: local cache path of the _suggestions.json wire sibling, when present. Threaded to the synthesis-conductor so Pass-2 can prefer an edited JSON (build_from_wire).
ADR-026: local cache path of the _suggestions-fan.json wire sibling, when present. Threaded to the conductor so a Hashi-edited fan doc resolves JSON-only (build_from_wire) in the standalone-fan path.

Spec 030 two-artifact split: local cache path of the garden-audit-wire.json sibling — the STRUCTURE source, always read by garden-audit-parser and joined to the markdown decisions by F-id. Set unconditionally so the conductor always passes --wire; null only when the sibling is genuinely absent (then the parser emits empty confirmed_items).

approved_garden_audits.description: Garden-audit docs approved via the top-level [x] Approved gate (ADR-1 revised, spec 030). Each entry carries wire_cache_path (structure source).

force_atomic_items.description: Items with [x] Force Atomic Note ticked

pending_approval.description: Docs awaiting user approval (not yet ticked)

skip_stems.description: F-9: stems to exclude from suggestion-conductor

handled.description: Inbox items routed by a tag-handler. Omitted entirely when the registry is empty (AC-5). Pass-1 skips handled items.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the inbox item.

handler.description: ID of the tag-handler that claimed this item.

vars.description: Captured segment values keyed by segment name (string→string).

target_path.description: Resolved vault-relative target path, or null when the target map had no entry for the captured vars.

marker.description: Anchor string in the target note (mirrors tag-handler config).

action.description: Action registry value from the handler config. Mirrors tag-handler.schema.json:43.

placement.description: Insertion position relative to the anchor.

oneOf.description: LLM directive from the handler config.
Mechanical template: ordered list of frontmatter field names.

compose.description: Compose directive from the handler config (string or array-of-strings).

output_format.description: Structure-aware output spec, carried verbatim from the handler config (spec 025). Already validated against tag-handler.schema.json at config-load time; kept permissive here to avoid triplicating the strict shape (canonical definitions: tag-handler.schema.json + tag-handler-group.schema.json).
